stepsTeacher.title: Expert Sourcing and Hiring Process
items: Comprehensive profiles showcasing academic background, certifications, and experience
A video assessment showcasing teaching style, communication skills, and technical readiness
An independent, thorough review of every application by the quality assurance team
Approval and verification: a verified badge for successful applicants only, with official public profiles

stepsTeacher.title: Initial Training and Onboarding for Teachers
items: A dedicated onboarding program covering platform policies and professional performance expectations
Mastering the interactive tools to use every platform feature with full effectiveness

stepsTeacher.title: Continuous Monitoring of Classrooms
items: Educational excellence: clear goals for every session, excellent time management, and academic accuracy
Active engagement: modern methods that keep students involved and avoid passive lecturing
Technical reliability: high audio and video quality with smooth, uninterrupted sessions
Professionalism and conduct: punctuality and a safe, supportive learning environment

stepsTeacher.title: Mutual Evaluation and Follow-up System
items: Students rate the content and the teacher, and write transparent reviews
Periodic performance reports from teacher to student to improve academic level
Effective intervention from the quality team to resolve complaints and issues quickly

stepsTeacher.title: Performance Levels and Continuous Development
items: A "Top Rated" badge for outstanding performers
Personalized development plans and constructive guidance to raise proficiency

home.whyChooseUsSubtitle: We choose quality at every step — from certifying teachers and training centers to tracking student progress and measuring results — to deliver a trustworthy learning experience worthy of your trust.

whyChooseUs.title: Certified Teachers and Training Centers
whyChooseUs.desc: We certify teachers and training centers according to strict standards to ensure competence, professionalism, and quality educational content.

whyChooseUs.title: Continuous Quality Assurance
whyChooseUs.desc: Our quality team periodically reviews sessions and performance to ensure the highest educational standards and continuously improve the experience.

whyChooseUs.title: Academic Support for All Stages and Specialties
whyChooseUs.desc: We provide educational support for school and university students across all stages and specialties, through a select group of expert teachers and academics.

whyChooseUs.title: Performance Reports and Development Plans
whyChooseUs.desc: We track student progress through periodic reports, prepare a monthly development plan, and provide a final report showing achievement level and recommendations for the next stage.

whyChooseUs.title: A Network of Trusted Training Centers
whyChooseUs.desc: We partner with certified training centers to offer professional programs and courses to the highest quality standards.

whyChooseUs.title: Trusted Reviews and Continuous Improvement
whyChooseUs.desc: We rely on reviews from students and parents, alongside quality team assessments, to ensure continuous development and maintain the highest quality standards.

about.heroSubtitle1: Ta'alam believes that good education should be accessible to everyone
about.heroSubtitle2: That's why we created a platform that brings the best teachers and trainers together in one place
about.storyP1: Our journey began with our belief in the importance of education in building a better future. We noticed how difficult it was to reach qualified teachers in an easy and safe way, so we worked on creating a platform that connects students with the best teachers across various academic and training fields.
about.storyP2: Every day, we work on improving your learning experience and providing an interactive, effective learning environment that achieves your goals and helps you grow.
about.visionText: To become the leading destination for e-learning in the region
about.missionText: Empowering students to easily reach qualified teachers while providing a professional and safe learning experience
